public_notes.title: People, Government And Reservation Dates
public_notes.text: Morongo's own account distinguishes an original reservation established in 1865 from a Presidential Executive Order dated May 15, 1876. The same site describes Morongo as a present sovereign government. Reservation dates describe institutions and land administration; they are not dates for the beginning of the people.

public_notes.title: Community Development And Education
public_notes.text: Morongo's account follows a bingo hall started by tribal members in 1983, a resort opening in late 2004 and a new school site in September 2010. Its Education Services page also describes college preparation, application and scholarship guidance. Read those services on Morongo's own site: eligibility and program requirements remain with the Tribe.
